text:
oliver: Heads-up: redis-timeout-high alert (prod) has fired ~27x since 03:00. It's paging infra rotations — noisy during the backup window. Any objections if we raise the threshold or put a short quiet window?

infra-bot: Alert detected: redis-timeout-high • group=infra-prod • 27 alerts • https://alerts.redwood.com/alerts/redis-timeout-high (auto)

keiko: Can you drop the latency panel link? want to check 90/95/99 quantiles.

oliver: Dash: https://dashboards.redwood.com/d/redis/redis-prod-latency?orgId=1&panelId=5 — 95/99q spike aligns with nightly backups around 02:50-03:10.

maya: If these are backup-induced, do we have a metric label for backup jobs so we can exclude them from the alert instead of changing thresholds?

dan: We don't currently label the backup client in all cases, that's a deploy change. Short term: I propose increasing the threshold from 2000ms -> 3000ms and bumping `for` to 10m to reduce flapping.

keiko: Would also vote for a temporary 2h quiet window for PD paging while we root-cause and update instrumentation.

oliver: Fine by me. I'd rather not blind ourselves to real issues though — make it a warning-level change not critical.

dan: I'll open the alert PR. Proposed rule snippet (short-term):
```
# alert: redis-timeout-high
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redis_client_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job)) > 3
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: warning
```
Ping if you prefer different quantiles or numbers.

maya: Where do logs live so I can grep for backup markers? Kibana link: https://logs.redwood.com/app/kibana#/discover?_a=(query:(query_string:(query:'service:redis AND env:prod')))

infra-bot: PagerDuty: Incident #INC12345 acknowledged by oliver — https://pd.redwood.com/incidents/INC12345

keiko: :thumbsup: Do the quiet window + rule change. We'll revisit after 24h of data.

oliver: I'll schedule a quiet window: 2026-03-18T09:00Z -> 2026-03-18T11:00Z. Dan — paste PR when ready.

dan: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/infra/alerts/pull/482 — includes rule edit and release notes. Setting CI->staging.

maya: I grepped logs and found backup job id `backup-20260318` correlated with spikes. Adding a note to the PR asking for a follow-up to tag backup metrics.

oliver: Thanks. I'll monitor dashboards during the window and report back. If pages continue, we'll rollback and investigate deeper.

keiko: Thanks team. Short follow-ups: 1) Dan — merge PR and schedule alert rollout after the quiet window starts. 2) Maya — file an infra ticket to ensure backup jobs emit `job=backup` label. 3) Oliver — monitor and escalate if needed.

oliver: On it. :eyes:
